payload.scientific_problem: test whether one generic admitted protonation restatement followed by existing task-blind structural proposal mechanisms produces diverse exact strict-eligible endpoints on the 5HT1B seed-2 support failure
payload.primary_model_output: complete protected Editing-V3 programs whose first primitive is atom_protonation_restate and whose optional tail is generated by an unchanged generic shallow, retained-core or shared route-complete mechanism
payload.central_claim_under_test: the charge-support repair becomes autonomous proposal support when the complete admitted protonation fiber is composed with existing structural proposal mechanisms without using a target name, teacher endpoint or reward
payload.experimental_setting: deterministic CPU-only zero-oracle production-yield gate on 5HT1B seed 2 at delta 0.6, plus a neutral-tertiary-amine reverse-transition contrast and a no-admitted-site abstention contrast
payload.support_version: Editing-V3 atom_protonation_restate; disabled in every historical Editing-V2 or V4 path unless this expert is explicitly selected

roots.label: primary_strict_support_failure
roots.selection_reason: the sealed exhaustion audit found zero old-expert eligible endpoints and three known strict endpoints outside charge-preserving support

roots.label: neutral_tertiary_reverse_transition_contrast
roots.selection_reason: predeclared neutral tertiary amine exercises the reverse admitted charge transition without sharing the primary target or source

roots.label: no_admitted_site_abstention_contrast
roots.selection_reason: predeclared supported root tests explicit abstention when the narrow protonation fiber is empty

endpoint_gate.similarity: Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, Tanimoto against the original root; >= delta
endpoint_gate.application_time: completed endpoint only; no primitive or structural-tail intermediate is filtered by task constraints

required_reporting: attempts and all abstentions by protonation action and structural lane
exact execution precision and unique complete endpoints
structural-validity, similarity, QED, SA and intersection funnels
fully eligible endpoint count and canonical/Murcko diversity
program lengths, first-action and total-charge transitions, lane provenance and runtime
zero oracle, docking, Modal and live-run access counts

acceptance_gates.primary: 5HT1B seed 2 has at least two unique exact fully eligible endpoints from autonomous candidate generation
acceptance_gates.exactness: every published candidate exact-replays from the original root and every action list begins with exactly one admitted atom_protonation_restate
acceptance_gates.abstention: an empty protonation fiber returns an explicit zero-candidate abstention rather than falling back to Editing-V2
acceptance_gates.historical_compatibility: all old proposal and route APIs retain their defaults; realized route actions are disclosed only under an explicit opt-in flag
acceptance_gates.validation: focused tests, Ruff, formatting and git diff checks pass

forbidden_actions: no Modal, docking or other oracle call
no live-run access, cancellation, restart or mutation
no endpoint injection, cell-to-winner lookup, teacher target or source-specific chemistry constant in autonomous proposal generation
no corpus, checkpoint, route-prior, frozen result or scored artifact mutation
no filtering of protected intermediate states by similarity, QED or SA
no claim of docking utility or benchmark improvement
payload.claim_boundary: This gate measures autonomous exact proposal and endpoint-feasibility support only. It does not evaluate docking reward, FiberControl selection, teacher recovery as an objective or T4 benchmark performance.
